copy.tagline_en: Manage build artifacts, Docker images, and package registries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage software build artifacts and container image versioning and distribution

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理构建产物、Docker 镜像和软件包。它可以生成多阶段 Dockerfile、配置容器注册表、设置版本策略和保留规则，以及自动化发布流程。
howto.when: 当你需要处理 Docker 镜像、发布软件包、存储构建产物或优化容器层时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个多阶段构建的 Dockerfile
say.note: Claude 会生成优化后的 Dockerfile

say.text: 将 Docker 镜像推送到 GitHub 容器注册表
发布 npm 包并设置语义版本
say.note: Claude 会生成版本号和发布脚本

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can manage build artifacts, Docker images, and packages. It generates multi-stage Dockerfiles, configures registries, sets versioning and retention policies, and automates publishing workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to handle Docker images, publish packages, store build artifacts, or optimize container layers.

say_en.text: Generate a multi-stage Dockerfile for my Node app
Push a Docker image to GitHub Container Registry
Publish an npm package with semantic versioning
say_en.note: Claude sets version and publish script
